story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯解释与其他F1车队“不同步”的研发策略
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森表示，车队决定较晚冻结2026年赛车设计，导致其与竞争对手“不同步”，赛季中期升级带来巨大性能提升，产生跳跃效应。W17赛车目前是场上最优秀的，赛季初在澳大利亚获得1-2名，并已取得八场胜利。

story.originalTitle: Mercedes explains "out of phase" developments compared with other F1 teams
story.summaryEn: Mercedes technical director James Allison said the team's decision to freeze its 2026 car design later put it "out of phase" with rivals, causing a leapfrog effect as in-season updates produce large performance gains. The W17 has been the class of the field, starting with a 1-2 in Australia and claiming eight wins so far.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释与其他F1车队“不同步”的研发策略
尽管赛季开局占得先机，但将W17设计推向极限的决定，使梅赛德斯在F1 2026年的研发竞争中“不同步”。
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森表示，车队决定较晚继续研发其2026年F1赛车，这使其与其他车队“不同步”，导致赛季中期升级带来巨大性能提升，产生跳跃效应。
W17迄今为止是场上最优秀的赛车，赛季初在澳大利亚获得1-2名，并在F1新时代的前11场比赛中取得八场胜利。尽管该车队是明确的冠军热门，但这并未阻止法拉利和迈凯伦在2026赛季凭借实力击败它获胜。
艾利森在车队的Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show播客中表示，车队在风洞中每周找到的圈速提升约为上赛季的“六到七倍”。这展示了在新规则下寻找提升与在更成熟、生命周期末端的规则下寻找提升之间的差异。
他还透露，车队选择较晚推进W17赛车的设计。当车队设计赛车时，通常会选择一个“设计冻结”点，届时赛车将按原样制造，进一步的研发将打包为赛季后期的升级。
梅赛德斯选择将冻结点推迟，压缩了制造时间，但允许其有效地将早期升级纳入首发赛车。艾利森表示，如果出现问题，这“毫无余量”，但这让车队得以利用持续的研发曲线。
“在空气动力学方面，风洞中每一周过去所带来的增益率，我们找到的圈速提升——那就是增益率——大约是去年的六到七倍，”艾利森说。
“大约每两个月0.5秒，差不多是这样，所以这真的非常陡峭。我们竭尽全力在年初推出一辆强大的赛车。
“谢天谢地，这是一次相当不错的努力。但我们研发策略的一件事是，我们在空气动力学方面和车身方面内部决定，要比以往任何时候都晚几周才定稿。而且我们要制定一个毫无余量的计划。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“由于那个计划，我们尽可能多地将那非常非常陡峭的研发斜率，在首场比赛的首辆赛车中体现出来，我认为这是人力所能及的极限。我们为此倾尽所有。其他车队或许没有以如此晚刹车、如此接近极限的方式到来。因此，他们更早地升级了赛车。”
艾利森表示，尽管这在年初为梅赛德斯带来了优势，但也让车队没有后续储备。这使其在推出升级方面比对手落后“一两场比赛”，因为它必须储备进一步的改进。
他解释说，当其他车队带来升级时，0.5秒的优势可能被完全抹平，这让梅赛德斯在等待自身研发以恢复优势期间可能处于脆弱状态。
这解释了车队之间性能的起伏；法拉利在巴塞罗那凭借可观的升级包找到了速度，而迈凯伦在匈牙利的新底板为其铺平了通往赛季首胜的道路。
“他们更早地修好了赛车，然后他们研发的第一批升级在赛季中更早到来。所以我们到来时，你知道，性能充沛，但全部用尽了，”艾利森继续说道。
“我们一直在加油以提供更多，我们有点不同步。由于提前到来，我们的研发计划现在比其他人的升级节奏慢一两场比赛。
“从我们看到的圈速来看，似乎每个人都处于与我们相同的斜率上。每个人都在以大约每两个月0.5秒的速度研发。因此，在研发周期中不同步半步，意味着你可以拥有像我们年初那样的0.5秒优势。
“一个研发周期就会将其抹平。这感觉相当可怕。但你也知道，油箱里还有存货。只是我们何时带来我们的部件的问题。
“我们的策略就是努力保持领先，并确保我们交付的下一批性能将恢复原状，恢复我们在赛季初投入的优势。
“我们只需挺过这些可怕的时刻，即其他人带来他们所有花哨的新部件的时候。”
detailEn: Mercedes explains "out of phase" developments compared with other F1 teams
Despite starting the season on the front foot, a decision to push the W17's design to the limit left Mercedes "out of phase" in F1's 2026 development battle

Mercedes technical director James Allison says the team's decision to keep developing its 2026 Formula 1 car late has put it "out of phase" with the other teams around it, causing a leapfrog effect as in-season updates produce large performance gains.

The W17 has been the class of the field so far, starting out the year with a 1-2 finish in Australia and going on to claim eight wins in the opening 11 races of F1's new era. Although the team is the firm championship favourite, this has not stopped the likes of Ferrari and McLaren beating it to victories on merit over the course of 2026.

Allison, speaking on the team's Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, stated that the team was finding "about six to seven times" more lap time per week in the wind tunnel compared to last season. This demonstrates the difference between finding gains under a new ruleset compared to a more mature, end-of-life set of regulations.

He also revealed that the team had elected to push the design of its W17 car late. When teams design their cars, they usually elect a "design freeze" point, where the car will be manufactured as-is and further developments will be packaged up as updates for later in the season.

Mercedes chose to move that freeze point back, compressing the manufacturing time but allowing it to effectively include early-season updates into the launch car. Allison says that this had "less than no contingency" if issues arose, but it allowed the team to take advantage of the continued development curve.
"Aerodynamically, the gain rate for each passing week in the wind tunnel, the amount of lap time we find – that's the gain rate – is about six to seven times what it was last year," Allison said.

"It's about half a second every two months, something like that, so that's really, really steep. And we did everything in our power to launch a car at the start of the year that was going to be strong.

"Thank goodness it was a fair effort. But one of the things about our development strategy was we took a decision internally on the aerodynamic side and on the bodywork side of the car that we were going to leave it later than we've ever left a car before, by several weeks. And that we were going to do a plan that had less than no contingency in it.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, George Russell, Mercedes

"As a result of that plan, we got as much, that very, very steep development slope, we got as much of that steep development slope in the first car at the first race as I think was humanly possible to get in there. And we emptied everything out to do that. Other teams maybe didn't arrive with quite the sort of quite such a late braking, as close to the wire result. As a consequence, they updated their car sooner."

Allison says that, although this offered Mercedes an advantage at the start of the year, it left the team with nothing in the pipeline. This has put it "a race or two" behind its rivals in terms of producing updates, as it had to stock up on its further refinements.

He explained that a half-second advantage could be completely wiped out by the time other teams bring their updates, and this has left Mercedes potentially vulnerable while it awaits its own developments in the hope of restoring that advantage.

This explains the ebb-and-flow in performance between the teams; Ferrari found pace in Barcelona with a considerable update package, while McLaren's new floor in Hungary greased its own path to a first race win of the season.

"They fixed their car earlier in time, they then were developing the first upgrade to arrive sooner in the season. So we arrived, you know, bristling with performance, but with all of it spent," Allison continued.

"We've been filling up our tanks to give more, and we're a bit out of phase. And our development program, as a result of arriving early, is now running a race or two after the update rates of the others.

"It appears, looking at the lap times we're seeing, that everyone's on this same slope we're on. Everyone is developing around about half a second every two months. And so with that, being out of phase half a step with the development cycle means that you can have half a second like we did at the start of the year.
"One development cycle will bring that to nothing. And that feels quite scary. But also, you know that there's a load in the tank. It's just a question of when we're going to bring our bits.

"Our strategy is just to try to keep our nose ahead and to make sure that the next lump of performance that we deliver will restore the status quo ante, restore the goodness we put in at the beginning of the season.
"We just have to ride out these scary events where other people bring all their fancy new bits."

梅赛德斯将设计冻结点推迟数周，压缩制造时间，将早期升级直接纳入首发赛车，但计划“毫无余量”。
由于提前耗尽升级，梅赛德斯升级节奏比对手慢“一两场比赛”，法拉利在巴塞罗那、迈凯伦在匈牙利凭借升级获胜。

Mercedes moved its design freeze point back by several weeks, compressing manufacturing time to include early-season updates in the launch car, but the plan had "less than no contingency."
Having spent its updates early, Mercedes is "a race or two" behind rivals in the development cycle, with Ferrari finding pace in Barcelona and McLaren winning in Hungary thanks to updates.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿的巴西大奖赛帽子揭幕，发布日期确认
法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.

detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
